decision: began a user-perspective sweep of every pi-pstack surface after confirming the whole gate set was already green
why: a green baseline means the remaining defects live in surface the suite never drove
evidence: 382 journey checks and 220 tests passed at HEAD 0034cbac

decision: made the todo widget send plain text lines outside the TUI
why: RPC clients only receive widget text, so a component factory was silently dropped and they saw no todo list at all
evidence: src/state.ts showState; scripts/verify-journeys.mjs todo widget checks

decision: stopped offering the typed free-text answer more than once in a multi-select question
why: it stayed the highlighted default, so a client answering with the default never finished and the journey harness exhausted a 4 GB heap

decision: resolved the worker directory and used a temp dir when the parent session is not persisted
why: a relative session dir scattered child transcripts into the working directory and made the transcript pointer change after resume

decision: derived the reported versions from provenance.json and the running SDK, and dropped the version literals from the host contract
why: the status command exists to report the environment, and a hardcoded version goes stale on another Pi release

decision: added real-CLI journeys for todo merge and cancel, the todo widget, every AskQuestion variant, task resume, the task lifecycle, readonly and workspace gates, steering, every persona, and the shell guards
why: each one covers a documented contract that only unit tests or nothing had touched

decision: reverted each fix in turn to prove its gate fails without it
why: a gate that passes either way proves nothing, so the observation method had to be checked too
evidence: mutation run of state.ts, questions.ts, worker-support.ts, and a reintroduced version literal
result: all four gates failed on the revert and passed on the restore

decision: added a structure gate against version literals in runtime source and a journey check that the archived kit rules stay out of the prompt
why: the same class of drift should not need a human to notice it again

decision: ran the repository gate set over the whole change
why: the finding is only real if the maintained gates agree
